note: Models shipped inside the APK (plan 02 §6). The build copies each file from the PC cache (~/.gradle/fonia-models/<cache>) into generated assets after checking size and SHA-256, and fails if it is missing; the app downloads nothing and has no INTERNET permission. Attribution for every entry goes in the app's NOTICE (spec/models/NOTICE).

models.name: ZIPA-small CR-CTC, 500k steps, int8
models.licenseCheck: Model card at the pinned commit declares license: cc-by-4.0; the authors' README table (lingjzhu/zipa @21e9e8aa) gives CC BY 4.0 for zipa-small-crctc-500k (checked at the source 2026-11-06, phones/MODELS.md). The download carries no separate licence file: the model card is the licence statement. Do NOT swap in the *-ns-* models (CC BY-NC-SA).
models.attribution: ZIPA-small CR-CTC (500k), (c) the ZIPA authors (Jian Zhu et al.), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Source: https://huggingface.co/anyspeech/zipa-small-crctc-500k. Used unmodified (int8 export by the authors). Paper: Zhu et al., "ZIPA: A family of efficient models for multilingual phone recognition", ACL 2025.

models.name: SpeD Parakeet-Ro 110M, CTC branch, int8
models.licenseCheck: Model card declares Apache-2.0 (base nvidia/parakeet-tdt_ctc-110m). The card does not name its training corpora; a research note says part may be non-commercial data, not verified in the paper.
